memory_candidates.content: In awk, a scalar variable named after a builtin function (e.g. `close`, which is also the file/pipe-closing builtin) triggers a syntax error the moment it's used in an expression like `index(window, "]")` assigned to it -- `awk: syntax error` with no clearer diagnostic. Rename the variable (e.g. `close_pos`) rather than debugging the awk grammar. Worth a quick scan for `length`, `index`, `substr`, `split`, `sub`, `close`, `system` etc. used as plain identifiers whenever writing an inline awk block in a shell script.

This codebase's suite_selection_select (scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh) resolves a touched path to covering test suites partly via a 'reference stratum': a bare `grep -l -F <basename> test-*.sh`. A test file's own COMMENT or assertion-label text that merely spells another file's exact basename (e.g. writing "report-format.md" in a human-readable description, with no functional dependency on it) is enough to make that test suite falsely appear to 'cover' the mentioned file. This silently flips any OTHER phase's `**Tier Justification**: __FULL_SWEEP__` claim for that file into a validate-artifact.sh-flagged mismatch, even though nothing about the actual behavior changed. When authoring test comments/labels that need to describe another context/formats or agents markdown file, describe it without spelling its literal filename (e.g. name the section/subsection instead) to avoid retriggering this false-positive.

When a validator check must grow a parallel literal-fixed-case token (a second or third mark sharing one well-formedness mechanism, e.g. CARRIED-UNVERIFIED/CORPUS-UNVERIFIED/COVERAGE-UNVERIFIED all needing 'a non-empty designator before the closing bracket'), parameterize the check over a bash array (CFD_TOKENS=(...)) and loop the SAME flatten/mention-suppress/bounded-window body per token, rather than duplicating the body per token or branching inside it. This keeps every token's recall-failure-mode protections (mention suppression, bounded window) automatically shared and unable to drift, and each new token addition becomes a one-line array extension plus fixtures, not a new code path.
